event.title: Highest temperature in Tokyo on July 25?
event.description:
This market will resolve to the temperature range that contains the highest temperature recorded at the Tokyo Haneda Airport Station in degrees Celsius on 25 Jul '26.

The resolution source for this market will be information from Wunderground, specifically the highest temperature recorded for all times on this day for the Tokyo Haneda Airport Station, available here: https://www.wunderground.com/history/daily/jp/tokyo/RJTT.

To toggle between Fahrenheit and Celsius, click the gear icon next to the search bar and switch the Temperature setting between °F and °C.

This market can not resolve until the first data point for the following date has been published on the resolution source.

The resolution source for this market measures temperatures to whole degrees Celsius (eg, 9°C). Thus, this is the level of precision that will be used when resolving the market.

Revisions to temperatures recorded within this market's timeframe will be considered until the first datapoint for the following date has been published, after which any alterations will not be considered.

eventMetadata.context_description: The closely matched probabilities around 31–33°C reflect short-range forecast uncertainty for Tokyo’s peak temperature on July 25, with ensemble guidance from agencies such as the Japan Meteorological Agency showing modest spread in afternoon maximums. Key differentiating factors include the strength and position of the North Pacific subtropical high, which modulates southerly flow and moisture advection, alongside urban heat-island amplification from Tokyo’s dense built environment that can add 1–2°C locally. Recent model runs indicate potential for scattered afternoon convection that could cap temperatures near 31°C or allow brief clearing to push readings to 33°C, while climatological July averages near 30–31°C provide the baseline against which current anomalies are assessed. Updated high-resolution runs and observations over the next 48 hours will refine these thresholds ahead of market resolution.
